observations: Initial FIRST_PERSON before any F5 switch has a visible bright scene. First THIRD_PERSON_BACK and FRONT screenshots are visually black even before the strict runtime black-screen proxy becomes true.
Later FIRST_PERSON frames remain black: camera switch triggers a persistent state rather than a geometry-only third-person view problem.
Cosmetic OFF after 24 ticks and selective Bloom OFF do not restore the already black scene.
After hideGui becomes true, all three camera types visibly render the player/sky/platform again. This contrasts the GUI-pre deferred submission route with the render-end route.
Recorded draw/read framebuffer IDs remain the main framebuffer (1), with complete status36053 and full1280x720 viewport; noGL errors. This alone does not prove blend/cache state correctness.

The runtime central60% ROI includes part of the custom HUD. Independent worldCoreWithoutHud avoids that overlay and detects the earliest black frames without treating the strict proxy as a readability acceptance standard.
Each stage retains its own tick. The final no-GUI frames carry an old GUI-pre observer entry because no GUI event occurs; that stale entry must not be treated as a current no-GUI GL sample.
scope: Saved raw screenshots and result copied after the baseline. No scene edits, source edits or extra client launch. Pixels are diagnostic scene-luma/color metrics; visual review remains necessary.
